extraction_scope: Worker-6 re-review converted automated mechanism locator notes into bounded, source-reviewed mechanism claims from article text, figures, and tables.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Aureobasidin A treatment is associated with oxidative stress, reduced mitochondrial membrane potential, reduced chitin signal, and altered neutral-lipid staining in the tested Candida strains.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: aureobasidin A in Candida glabrata 109, Candida albicans 1114, and Candida albicans 12-99
mechanism_claims.limitations: Claim is bounded to cellular phenotype assays; exact figure-level bar values were not converted beyond values stated in article text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Aureobasidin A increases membrane-stress susceptibility and DNA leakage signals, supporting a bounded membrane-integrity effect rather than a fully resolved molecular target mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports phenotype-level membrane integrity evidence; it does not assign a single direct molecular binding event.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Efflux-pump checkerboard data support a source-bounded interaction signal for CaCDR2p+ and a fluconazole MIC reduction context for other overexpressor strains, with only CaCDR2p+ classified as synergistic by FICI in Table 4.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: S. cerevisiae efflux-pump overexpression strains exposed to aureobasidin A plus fluconazole
direct_assay_types: checkerboard FICI assay in efflux-pump overexpression strains
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not generalize to all efflux pumps; the table-supported synergy classification is specific to CaCDR2p+.
